instruction: Determine the appropriate tool among ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD, then complete the task with it. Launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to build and solve a 2D axisymmetric structural model of a thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure. Physical problem: Axisymmetric thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system for the axisymmetric cross-section. - X is the radial direction. - Y is the axial direction. - The cylinder has an inner diameter of 50 mm and an outer diameter of 100 mm. - Therefore, model the radial domain from X = 25 mm to X = 50 mm. - The axial thickness is 10 mm. - Model the rectangular axisymmetric cross-section: - 25 ≤ X ≤ 50 mm - 0 ≤ Y ≤ 10 mm - Do not model or constrain a symmetry axis at X = 0, because the cylinder has a central hole and the axis is outside the modeled annular cross-section. Model parameters: - Material: linear elastic steel - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3 - Element type: appropriate two-dimensional plane or axisymmetric element formulation with axisymmetric option enabled - Mesh: global element size 5 mm Boundary conditions and load: - Inner cylindrical surface at X = 25 mm: apply an internal pressure of 10 MPa acting on the cylinder wall. - Outer cylindrical surface at X = 50 mm: free surface. - Axial faces: - At Y = 0 mm: constrain axial displacement UY = 0. - At Y = 10 mm: constrain axial displacement UY = 0. - Do not constrain radial displacement UX on the inner or outer cylindrical surfaces. Analysis type: - Static structural analysis. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
